weather.summary: Dry, 13°C, light wind (11 km/h) from the west
weather.impact: No significant impact. A dry, firm pitch slightly favours fast ball circulation and the Kingsbridge passing game.

referee.name: Alan Ostrowski (fictional)
referee.style: Plays advantage a lot, lets physical duels go, strict on simulation and on tactical fouls that stop counter-attacks.
referee.impact: Good for Northgate's duels in midfield; risky for a hot-headed holding midfielder who has to stop counters.

stakes.summary: Matchday 9. Kingsbridge (4th) need a win to stay in touch with the top three. Northgate (9th) are unbeaten in four away games and would be happy with a point.
stakes.importance: high for Kingsbridge, medium for Northgate

home.previous_match: Cup round 3 away at Pellham Town on Wednesday, won on penalties after 120 minutes
home.load: high: 120 minutes three days ago, six starters played the full match

away.previous_match: League match on Saturday (1-1 vs Eastmoor United)
away.travel: 210 km by coach, arrived the evening before

head_to_head.note: Northgate built from the back in a 4-3-3 with Duarte dropping between the centre-backs, then went direct in a 4-4-2 after the hour; the Scout's baseline (script/cup/match_script.json)
Northgate scored on the counter; Kingsbridge won with a late set-piece header
Kingsbridge 71% possession, 0.9 xG against a low block

last_matches.note: Dominant, scored twice from the counter-press
Conceded on a ball in behind the high line
Late winner after switching to a back three
Could not break down a low 5-4-1 block
Brannigan sent off in the 70th minute while 2-1 down

absences.impact: Holt is the fastest centre-back in the squad and normally covers for Dijkhuis. Without him the pairing is slower and the high line is riskier.
One less attacking option on the bench.

mental.summary: Confident: 4 wins and 2 draws in the last 6. Expected to win at home.
mental.behind_record: Struggle emotionally when behind: 2 red cards this season, both while trailing.
mental.pressure_handling: Good at home, nervous when chasing a result late.

coach_profile.name: Ingrid Solberg
coach_profile.behaviour_when_behind: Goes to a back three with wing-backs and an extra striker (done 3 times this season, one winner).
coach_profile.behaviour_when_ahead: Keeps the ball, rarely drops deep.
coach_profile.game_plan: Dominate the ball, high press on Northgate's weak build-up, overload the left side through Kovač and Nakamura-Brooks, keep Brannigan as the anchor.

bench.summary: A clear plan B in target man Moore-Asante and crossing wing-back Castellanos; a strong defensive midfielder (Achterberg). Little creativity apart from Eriksen.

set_pieces.defending_corners: zonal (six in zones, two on man)
set_pieces.note: Dangerous from corners at home; Ferreira-Lind is weak on high balls into a crowded box.

structure.build_up: Back three in build-up: Mbeki inverts next to Brannigan, Okafor-Hale stays high. Goalkeeper used as an extra passer, 85% short goal kicks.
structure.pressing: High press, man-oriented in Northgate's half. Triggers: back pass to the goalkeeper, pass to a full-back near the touchline, bad first touch.
structure.defensive_line: high (about 45 m from own goal when in possession)
attacking_patterns: Left-side overload: Kovač in the left half-space, Mbeki inverting, Nakamura-Brooks 1v1
Lindqvist runs to the near post
Visser late runs into the box
known_weaknesses: Rest defence with only two centre-backs when the full-backs push on
Struggles against low blocks (0-0 vs Saltmarsh)

last_matches.note: Equaliser in the 88th minute conceded from a cross
Struggled when they had to make the game themselves
Pressed into mistakes in their own build-up

absences.impact: First-choice centre-back and organiser. Okoro is now the only aerial back-up for the 5-4-1.

mental.summary: Resilient underdog, unbeaten in four away games, good at defending a lead.
mental.behind_record: Rarely come back from behind (1 point from losing positions).
mental.pressure_handling: Calm under pressure, but they fade late: 5 of their 10 goals conceded came after the 75th minute.

coach_profile.name: Darren Kowalczyk
coach_profile.behaviour_when_behind: Brings on an extra striker but keeps the 4-4-2.
coach_profile.behaviour_when_ahead: Goes to a 5-4-1 with an extra centre-back (done 4 times this season).
coach_profile.game_plan: Stay compact in a 4-4-2 mid/low block, jump on passes into Kingsbridge's holding midfielder, then hit Adeyemi-Clarke early in behind the high line. Avoid playing out from the back against the press.

bench.summary: Halvorsen (creative midfielder) and Diallo-Kerr (pace) can change a game; Okoro for defending a lead. Little depth at full-back.

set_pieces.note: Strong in the air thanks to Hollander, Petrov and Okoro. Achebe-Ward regularly loses his man at set pieces. Gallagher's long throws are a real weapon.

structure.build_up: Back four in build-up, mostly long: goal kicks long to Petrov (70%). Saarinen is weak with his feet.
structure.pressing: Mid/low block in a 4-4-2. Trigger: a pass into Kingsbridge's holding midfielder → the nearest striker and central midfielder jump.
structure.marking: zonal with man-marking in the box
attacking_patterns: Early long ball in behind for Adeyemi-Clarke
Lindgren carries the ball on the counter
known_weaknesses: Little control when they have to make the game

KBA-06.note: One red card this season, 4 yellows in 8 matches

KBA-10.note: League leader in key passes (2.9 per 90)

KBA-19.note: 4 headed goals as a substitute this season

NGR-01.note: Highest save percentage in the league (78%)

NGR-06.note: Most tackles in the league (4.1 per 90)

matchups.title: High line vs elite pace
matchups.home_side: Kingsbridge's high defensive line with slow Dijkhuis
matchups.expectation: Northgate's best route to goal. Each ball over the top is a big chance.

matchups.title: Fast winger vs vulnerable right-back
matchups.expectation: Kingsbridge will target their left flank; card risk for Quiroga.

matchups.title: High press vs weak build-up
matchups.away_side: Saarinen's poor distribution, Northgate's long build-up
matchups.expectation: Kingsbridge win the ball high up; Northgate avoid playing out and go long.

matchups.title: Creator between the lines vs compact block
matchups.expectation: Little space for Kovač; Kingsbridge depend on width and crosses.

matchups.title: Hot-headed anchor vs counter-attacks
matchups.expectation: Brannigan will have to commit fouls to stop counters. Card risk is high with a strict referee.

matchups.title: Set pieces: zonal Kingsbridge vs aerial Northgate
matchups.home_side: Kingsbridge zonal defending, keeper weak on crosses
matchups.away_side: Northgate aerial strength and Gallagher's long throws
matchups.expectation: Set pieces are Northgate's second route to goal. At the other end Achebe-Ward's marking is a target.

matchups.title: Late fatigue
matchups.home_side: Kingsbridge: 120 minutes three days ago, strong bench
matchups.away_side: Northgate fade late (5/10 goals conceded after 75')
matchups.expectation: Both sides tire. Whoever's bench brings fresh energy decides the final 20 minutes.
